notes:
BUILD 71
- All three cars remodelled: round tube cages, shaped bonnets and doors, mudguards, grilles, round lamps, proper seats, knobbly tyres on dished rims, and a coil spring over every wheel that squashes with the suspension.
- Cars are solid from nose to tail now: they stop against trees, walls, barrels, boxes, other vehicles and anything alive (which is still hurt, and thrown aside). A parked car you run into is knocked on.
- Wheels ride up over rocks, ore and stumps instead of ignoring them.
- The cargo on the truck and buggy opens properly, and the prompt says CARGO.
- Wrench (100 metal fragments, level 1 bench): hit a car with it to repair the body, 8 scrap and 30 metal fragments a swing.
- The pick-up and truck pull away slower (the truck slowest); the buggy is harder to roll and takes far less damage from knocks.
- Helicopters are a good deal faster than any car again.
- Higher up is colder.
- Dying in a wrecked car says Car crash. /car puts the car on whatever you are pointing at instead of under it.
- With the gun out in a car, driving no longer drops it into the running pose.
